scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix flowai-studio-backend run typecheck && npm --prefix flowai-studio-frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix flowai-studio-backend run lint && npm --prefix flowai-studio-frontend run lint:ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix flowai-studio-backend run test:ci && npm --prefix flowai-studio-backend run test:e2e -- --runInBand
scripts.build: npm --prefix flowai-studio-backend run build && npm --prefix flowai-studio-frontend run build
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run compose:validate
